column1: # One row per offline bundle.  Nothing here is a fixed URL: the resolver asks
# the public Kiwix catalogue for the newest build of each name and pins the
# result, so an updated edition needs no code change.
#   name        the catalogue id (becomes <name>_<YYYY-MM>.zim on disk)
#   flavour     maxi | nopic | mini | -   (largest to smallest)
#   size_gib    last measured download size, used for the disk budget
#   tier        essential | core | extra      (download order and profiles)
#   label       the friendly name shown on the portal
#   query       keyword sent to the catalogue to find this entry
# Tabs, not spaces.  Keep rows sorted by tier, then smallest first, so the
# library becomes useful within minutes instead of after the big files.
